llm_response.reason: The website at https://black.choko.sa.com/ mimics Google's search homepage in appearance and links, but is hosted at an unrelated subdomain with no affiliation to Google (confirmed by WHOIS). This matches scam characteristic #16 (Mimics or spoofs legitimate company names, logos, and website designs), which is associated with phishing or scam attempts seeking to deceive users. No legitimate business activity was detected; the use of Google's branding and UI on an unrelated domain is a strong indicator of an intent to scam users (e.g., phishing).
